title: Import data
description: Load what you already have from Excel or CSV: suppliers, products, customers and opening stock. Every file is checked first and nothing is saved until you confirm.
order: Suggested order: suppliers, then products, then customers, then opening stock (it needs the products). Opening contracts need the customers; then sign the reconciliation under Settings > Migration.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Names, phones, tax numbers and payment terms.

products.title: Products
products.description: SKU, names, prices, categories, warranty and serial tracking.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Names, phones, national IDs and work details.

opening_stock.title: Opening stock
opening_stock.description: What you hold today in one branch, with the cost of each unit.

opening_contracts.title: Open installment contracts
opening_contracts.description: Each customer's open contracts with what is left on every installment, the amount paid before and the guarantors. Import customers first.

opening_cash.title: Opening cash
opening_cash.description: The balance of each safe and bank account today. Posted once, on an account with no movements.

template.label: Download template
template.failed: The template could not be downloaded. Try again.

file.help: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows. The first row holds the column names.
file.branchHelp: The stock in this file is counted in this branch.

columns.title: Match your columns
columns.help: We matched the columns of your file to our fields. Change any that are wrong. Fields marked * are required.

review.title: Result of the check
review.ok: No errors. Nothing has been saved yet.
review.bad: The file has errors. Nothing was saved. Fix the file and check it again.
review.moreErrors: Only the first {shown} of {total} errors are listed.
review.downloadFailed: The errors file could not be opened.
review.importHelp: Import is available only when the file has no errors.

contracts.title: Contracts in this file
contracts.lateNote: {amount} on {count} contracts is already late. The nightly overdue check will warn about it tomorrow; no fee is ever added.
contracts.feesNote: Fees in the old records are not imported: only what is left of the installment price is.
contracts.more: Only the first {shown} contracts are listed.
contracts.migrationLink: Open the migration page to see the reconciliation report

confirm.title: Import {kind}?
confirm.text: {create} will be added, {update} updated and {unchanged} left as they are. The import is all or nothing.
confirm.stockText: {create} lines will be added, {update} updated and {unchanged} left as they are in stock. The import is all or nothing.

running.title: Importing…
running.text: This can take a minute for a big file. You can leave this page; the import continues and appears in the History tab.

failed.title: The import did not run
failed.text: Nothing was saved. If errors are listed below, fix the file and import it again. Otherwise try again in a few minutes.

history.emptyHint: Imports you check or run appear here.
history.cancelText: The checked file is dropped and cannot be imported. You can upload it again.
history.failedLoad: The history could not be loaded.

rowErrors.IMPORT_INVALID_VALUE: The value is not valid for this column.
rowErrors.IMPORT_AMBIGUOUS_MATCH: More than one existing record matches this row.
rowErrors.IMPORT_APPLY_FAILED: This row could not be saved.
rowErrors.PRODUCT_ARCHIVED: The product is archived. Restore it first.
rowErrors.PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: No product has this code. Import the product first.
rowErrors.PRODUCT_SKU_TAKEN: Another product already has this SKU.

rowErrors.PRODUCT_SERIAL_LOCKED: Serial tracking cannot change: the product already has stock movements.
rowErrors.CATEGORY_DEPTH: Categories go one level deep: a category and one sub-category.
rowErrors.CATEGORY_NAME_TAKEN: This category name already exists under another category.
rowErrors.CUSTOMER_NATIONAL_ID_TAKEN: Another customer already has this national ID.
rowErrors.CUSTOMER_NATIONAL_ID_LOCKED: This customer already has a different national ID.
rowErrors.NATIONAL_ID_INVALID: The national ID is not valid (14 digits).
rowErrors.SUPPLIER_PHONE_TAKEN: Another supplier already has this phone.
rowErrors.SUPPLIER_NAME_TAKEN: Another supplier already has this name.
rowErrors.SERIAL_INVALID: The serial number is not valid.
rowErrors.SERIAL_TAKEN: This serial number is already in the shop.

rowErrors.UNIT_REQUIRED: This product has serial numbers: give one row per serial.
rowErrors.OPENING_STOCK_LOCKED: This product already has movements in this branch. Use a stock adjustment instead.
rowErrors.TAX_CLASS_NOT_FOUND: No tax class has this name.
rowErrors.MODULE_NOT_IN_PLAN: Your plan does not include this feature.

rowErrors.POLICY_NOT_SET: Publish an installment policy in Settings first.

errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Only Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files can be imported.
